power_leds_nadditions.component.property: Red Forward Voltage
Typical forward voltage of the red die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
Red Series Resistance
Internal series resistance of the red die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
Red Breakdown Voltage
Reverse voltage at which the red die breaks down and is destroyed. LEDs block reverse current below this.
Red Wavelength
Dominant wavelength of the red die.
Red Luminous Intensity
Typical luminous intensity of the red die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
Green Forward Voltage
Typical forward voltage of the green die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
Green Series Resistance
Internal series resistance of the green die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
Green Breakdown Voltage
Reverse voltage at which the green die breaks down and is destroyed. LEDs block reverse current below this.
Green Wavelength
Dominant wavelength of the green die.
Green Luminous Intensity
Typical luminous intensity of the green die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
Blue Forward Voltage
Typical forward voltage of the blue die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
Blue Series Resistance
Internal series resistance of the blue die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
Blue Breakdown Voltage
Reverse voltage at which the blue die breaks down and is destroyed. LEDs block reverse current below this.
Blue Wavelength
Dominant wavelength of the blue die.
Blue Luminous Intensity
Typical luminous intensity of the blue die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
Min. Visible Current
Below this forward current the LED gives no visible light.
tooltip.power_leds_nadditions.dismantle: Shift + right-click to take apart into single LEDs
power_leds_nadditions.component.property: Red Max Power
Datasheet power rating of the red die. Real LEDs only fail well above it, once the junction reaches its maximum temperature.
Green Max Power
Datasheet power rating of the green die. Real LEDs only fail well above it, once the junction reaches its maximum temperature.
Blue Max Power
Datasheet power rating of the blue die. Real LEDs only fail well above it, once the junction reaches its maximum temperature.
Max Junction Temperature
At this junction temperature the die overheats: smoke, a spark, then it is dead. Fans on the board cool it.
tooltip.power_leds_nadditions.repair_whi: Craft with 1 Quartz + the ore of each burnt die to repair
